definitions: An American adult animated sitcom created by Raphael Bob-Waksberg.
The titular character from the animated sitcom, an anthropomorphic horse who was the star of a popular 1990s sitcom.
examples: BoJack Horseman explores themes of depression and addiction.
Many fans empathize with BoJack Horseman despite his flaws.
The show BoJack Horseman is known for its dark humor.
